channel.title: We Love Scripture
channel.description: We Love Scripture exists to build a generation rooted in Christ. Through sound teaching, honest discussions, and Spirit-filled encouragement, we explore the unchanging Word of God in a changing world. For teens, students, and young adults hungry for more than surface-level faith, this is your place to go deeper, live stronger, and hold fast to the hope we have in Jesus.
channel.author: Joshua Olunlade

episodes.title: Men Like Trees
episodes.description:

episodes.title: No Days Off!
episodes.description:
"It's always easier to pray when we're faced with a challenge or a pressing need, but what about when life is calm and there's no urgent reason to pray?

episodes.description:
